text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby missed out on claiming the 
Yushun Himba (Oaks). Feeling an 
extraordinary amount of fatigue after the 
race, she senses her limits at 
medium-to-long distances.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby suggests running the Rose 
Stakes as a prep race for the Shuka Sho. 
Her Trainer agrees, making it the next 
target.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Convinced that Daiichi Ruby's true 
aptitude lies in sprinting, the Trainer 
struggles between steering her toward her 
natural strengths and respecting her own 
wishes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Daiichi Ruby realized her true 
aptitude. The sprint division was indeed a 
path where she could leave her mark. 
However, walking the Royal Road was her 
duty as a member of her house.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby resolves to conquer her 
distance issues at the summer training 
camp. She sets her sights on her next 
goal, the Rose Stakes.
